queries: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), type_metrics AS (SELECT transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_metrics WHERE transaction_count > average_count;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count, AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS NUMERIC)) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(c.transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(CAST(c.transaction_count AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(x.total_count, 0)) AS average_share, AVG(c.transaction_count - x.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts c CROSS JOIN totals x WHERE c.transaction_count > x.average_count
